name: USB out
author: pcppcp
description: Shift + help, then T2. Turn blue to choose MASTER or MASTER + TRACKS. USB always has six channels: main left and right on 1 and 2, and the four tape tracks on 3 to 6. With MASTER the track channels are silent. With MASTER + TRACKS they carry the four tape tracks, taken before the faders. MASTER (the default) uses less processing. On Windows, remove the old OP-1 audio device if it still shows two channels.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
